basics.name: Alex Profir
basics.label: Senior Full-Stack Engineer
basics.summary: I build applications from the ground up with a strong emphasis on reliability, client satisfaction, and product quality. I work closely with stakeholders to turn early ideas into clear requirements, then deliver them with the testing and monitoring that keep the product working once it's live. I'm highly collaborative and enjoy working in team environments, and I'm open to remote or hybrid roles.

work.name: Independent Contractor
work.summary: Web, mobile and backend development, including microservices, on scalable cloud infrastructure, through my own company. Clients include MoreDevs, where I continued work on its cybersecurity platform until Oct 2026, and a faith-based social network. I combine hands-on coding with spec-driven development and agentic coding, delivering features with higher velocity and better quality.
